plugins.name: zhixing-dojo
plugins.description: A learning dojo for truly mastering new topics from scratch: puzzle-first lessons, stories and interactive animations, mastery-gated progression, Bloom-layered checks. Knowing and doing as one — nothing counts as learned until it's tested.

skills.name: hunt
skills.description: Bug Hunt — audit an AI-style artifact with planted flaws. Use when the user wants to practice reviewing AI output, or to earn a stage's 5th star.

skills.name: learn
skills.description: Lessons through the dojo's six-step loop. Use when the user wants to learn a subject, study a technology from scratch, or continue their training.
headings: The lesson loop (six fixed steps; playbook in teaching-method.md)

skills.name: map
skills.description: The learning map — knowledge tree with mastery stars, streak, rank tier, and review backlog.

skills.name: quiz
skills.description: Checks on learned dojo material. Use when the user wants to be quizzed, or to take a chapter Boss Battle.

skills.name: review
skills.description: Spaced-repetition review of dojo material. Use when the user wants to review, or to clear due cards.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: One-time dojo setup — creates the learning archive and records global preferences. Rerun anytime to change preferences.

skills.name: teach
skills.description: Feynman teach-back to apprentice A-Dai. Use when the user wants to explain a learned concept to prove they understand it, or to earn a stage's 4th star.
